top_signals.title: Saudis Offer Oil From Near Oman in Possible Sign of Shuttling
top_signals.summary: Saudi Arabia is offering to sell oil from off the coast of Oman, a sign that the kingdom may be following the United Arab Emirates in shuttling more barrels through the Strait of Hormuz.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
